headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for all headings above 32px. Use uppercase and wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]) for overlines/labels.

body.usage: Use for dense data, KDS tickets, and POS item lists. High legibility is crucial for the ERP workflow.

colors.guidelines: Use deep neutral surfaces. Apply semantic colors for transaction states and KDS timers. Ensure 4.5:1 contrast for text. DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use flat solid surfaces with 1px subtle borders (border-border). Avoid glassmorphism for clinical/data-heavy POS and KDS screens to maximize clarity.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use subtle ambient shadows for elevated components, but rely more on borders for separation in dark mode.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use grid borders (border-r border-b border-border/40) for dense KDS grids or POS item lists.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense dashboards and POS.

components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow.
components.buttons: Modern sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md) styles. Primary action should use the vivid blue accent. Include clear hover and focus states.
components.inputs: Use Shadcn UI inputs, customized with dark backgrounds and vivid blue focus rings.
components.tables: High density, clean borders, alternating row colors (subtle) if necessary.
components.kds_ticket: Card-based ticket. Header color changes based on SLA (Green -> Yellow -> Red). Highlight ADD/REMOVE modifiers explicitly with background badges or colored text.
components.pos_table_map: Visual floor plan with clickable table units. Color-code tables (Open: Gray, Seated: Blue, Ordered: Yellow, Served: Green).

grids.kds_grid: High density grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5. Tight gap (gap-4).
grids.pos_grid: Split view: 2/3 for floor plan/menu grids, 1/3 for current order ticket.
grids.dashboard_grid: Bento style for KPIs. Base grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Wide gaps.

layouts.app_shell: Sidebar navigation (collapsible) + Top header (Tenant switcher, User profile, Current Location) + Main content area.
layouts.pos_layout: Header for location/tenant info. Main area: visual table map (or menu grid) on left, cart/order summary on right.
layouts.spacing: Use Tailwind scale (p-2, p-4, p-6). For POS, keep it dense (p-2 to p-4) to maximize screen real estate.

motion.interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Click/press states. Focus states.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease). Do NOT use transition-all.
motion.kds_updates: Subtle flash or slide-in animation when a new ticket arrives in KDS.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text.
accessibility.focus: Always provide visible focus indicators (ring-2 ring-primary).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='pos-table-4').

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the UI primarily in Polish (e.g. 'Stoliki', 'Kasa', 'Zamówienia', 'KDS', 'Ustawienia').
Use Phosphor Icons via @phosphor-icons/react. Add `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react`.
Implement Shadcn UI for standard components (Dialogs, Select, Tabs, Inputs) and customize them for the dark theme.
For the POS visual table floor plan, create clickable rectangular/circular 'Stoliki' (Tables) over a grid background. Color-code by status (e.g., green for paid/open, yellow for occupied).
In the KDS view, display order tickets in a tight CSS grid. Dynamically change ticket header color based on SLA timers (Green: < 10m, Yellow: 10-20m, Red: > 20m).
Modifiers in KDS MUST clearly highlight 'ADD' (e.g., green text/badge) and 'REMOVE' (e.g., red text/badge with strikethrough).
All interactive elements must include 'data-testid' for testing purposes.
Ensure you write .js or .jsx files, not .tsx files.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Do not use flat simplistic gradients.
Do NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
Do NOT center align the app container in CSS (no .App { text-align: center; }).
Use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
Use pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Ensure the UI uses dark mode primarily with deep neutral surfaces and high-contrast text, avoiding pure black backgrounds.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Prioritize optical alignment over geometrical alignment.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable for general sections, but for POS and KDS rely on compact spacing (p-2, p-4) to avoid excessive scrolling during fast-paced restaurant operations.
Provide clear feedback (toast, visual state change) for all operations like order creation, modifier addition, and KDS status change.
Keep typography scalable but strict. Use fluid typography or clamp functions for main headers to avoid overflow.
